panels.acts: Official Gazette of the City of Zagreb
panels.safetyOpen: This layer is open to everyone, without scanning and without a time limit.
panels.cultureStage1: In stage one this layer has no live data yet. The plan: Europeana (CC0 metadata, key required), the National and University Library's Digital Collections (public-domain works with attribution), DiZbi HAZU, Wikimedia Commons, libraries and museums from the city's FeatureServers, and the Guru za kulturu programme with a link. Radio and HRT appear only as programme and news text with a "Listen" link to the broadcaster's own player.

scan.title: Unlock a view of Zagreb
scan.intro: Scan the QR code on the screen or type the code below. Ten minutes from a screen, five from another person's phone.
scan.codeHint: Eight characters, e.g. ABCD-EFGH. The letters I, L and O do not exist: type 1 or 0.
scan.confirmTitle: Is the same code on the screen?
scan.confirmHint: Check that this code matches the one on the other device. Unlocking opens the view on both.

errors.network: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
errors.incomplete: The code is incomplete. Type all eight characters.
errors.notOurs: That is not a Vidikovac code. Scan the QR code on the screen.
errors.bad-request: The code is not in the right form.
errors.code-unknown: That code does not exist or has passed. Look at the screen and scan again.
errors.code-expired: The code has expired. The screen already shows a new one.
errors.code-used: That code has already been used. Wait for the next one on the screen.
errors.screen-offline: The screen is offline right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.same-network: This screen and your phone share a network. Turn off Wi-Fi and scan on mobile data.
errors.slow-down: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.rate-limited: Too many attempts from this network. Wait a minute.
errors.revoked: This screen has been switched off.

scanner.hint: Point the camera at the QR code on the screen.
scanner.denied: Camera access was refused. Type the code instead.
scanner.unavailable: No camera is available. Type the code instead.
scanner.struggling: Hold steady, or move a little closer.

session.expiring60: One minute left. What you are looking at stays on screen after the session ends.
session.expired: The session has ended. The view is frozen. A nearby screen unlocks another ten minutes.
session.noRoom: No session details. Scan the code on a screen.
session.shareBody: Another person scans this code or types the letters at zagreb.aningfilm.hr/s. They get their own five minutes; your time does not change. The code changes every 30 seconds.
session.shareUnavailable: This session came from another person and cannot be shared further.
session.shareTooLate: Too little time left to share.
session.openTier: The safety layer stays open at /hitno.

kiosk.invitation: Scan for ten minutes of Zagreb. Pay with attention, not money.
kiosk.invitationEn: Skeniraj za 10 minuta pogleda na Zagreb. Plaćaš pažnjom, ne novcem.
kiosk.typeCode: or type the code at zagreb.aningfilm.hr/s
kiosk.offline: The screen is offline right now. No code can be issued.
kiosk.notProvisioned: This screen is not set up. Open the provisioning link from the admin account.
kiosk.revoked: This screen has been switched off. Contact the operator.

export.shareCopied: Sharing is not available; the link was copied.
